status_summary: FHWA published a final rule on 2025-04-18, effective 2025-05-19, removing the requirement that states and metropolitan planning organizations set declining carbon dioxide targets under the greenhouse gas measure. On 2025-03-10 two prior-administration memos were rescinded: the December 2021 memo that urged states to use infrastructure law funds on existing infrastructure before new capacity, and a February 2023 memo that superseded it. An undated Eno Transportation Weekly article also reports that strategic priority sections were removed from program guidance reissued from April 2026. These steps cover the named items; the broader refocusing and reduction of federal involvement in local projects is not shown in the sources found.

timeline.event: FHWA rescinded the December 2021 memo on use of infrastructure law funds and a February 2023 memo that superseded it.
FHWA published a final rule repealing the declining carbon dioxide target requirement of the greenhouse gas measure.
The greenhouse gas measure repeal took effect.
